notes.title: Godspell Defender out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5721558/48428b454a6888349ab86d0116627853955593cc.png[/img]

Godspell Defender is a little arcade action game designed to satisfy in short bursts.  Easy to pick up, you'll be making massive combos within no time.  Although simple, the gameplay isn't mindless.  Timing your shots to make the best combos is the only way to win.  Some combos are better than others so maximizing each shot is of paramount importance in order to win.

Out now on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5721558/68377873f078d095e40ed4fedd98b58a3bd9a3e8.png[/img]

notes.title: Space Choice Rework and Rebalance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39892898/21e62a7a3cc254dfca7889ba29867742fb035267.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]COMPLETE REBALANCE[/b][/h1]

Hey everyone, we've completely rebalanced Space Choice.  It's now more in line with the casual space strategy game we originally set out to make.  You have more time to make decisions and decisions should be more impactful.  As well, all game elements have been rebalanced to accommodate this.  Also, many bug fixes that should make the experience more pleasant.

notes.title: Blade Flash Death - Out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5721558/98f2f4083af6de718969fb288df48b775a982ffe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5721558/a46a6b0ce2342d9798ff563dc571a10cc948cd0f.png[/img]

Control your samurai by manipulating the timeline. Be diligent with each movement you make. When ready, press play and watch the scene unfold. If you've thought-out your movements carefully, you will be the last samurai standing. This is our little art game, Blade Flash Death. It's a small passion project that we wanted to share with whoever is interested in this extremely niche idea.

I really like the kind of [b]"Dance of the Samurai"[/b] theme the game has. It's kind of like [i]ballet with swords[/i].

Out now and it's [b]completely free[/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451540/Blade_Flash_Death/]Blade Flash Death - LINK HERE[/url]




Also, in case you've missed it, people seem to be enjoying Space Choice with a [b]Very Positive[/b] rating.
